zh: 世界显示启动，但大厅搜不到房间
直连代码也无法进入
en: Worlds appear running but the lobby cannot find the room
Direct connect also fails

zh: 查看 server_log.txt 是否出现 E_INVALID_TOKEN
en: Check server_log.txt for E_INVALID_TOKEN

zh: Klei 游戏令牌无效或与房间不匹配
en: The Klei game token is invalid or does not match the room

zh: 进入房间设置，更换正确的游戏令牌
也可以使用平台默认游戏令牌
重启房间
en: Open room settings and replace the game token
Alternatively, use the platform default game token
Restart the room

reason.zh: 日志显示游戏令牌失效，可改用平台默认游戏令牌
reason.en: The log shows the game token is invalid; use the platform default game token

reason.zh: 更换令牌后需要重启房间才能生效
reason.en: Restart the room after changing the token

risk.zh: 更换令牌后需要等待大厅重新注册，期间玩家可能搜不到房间
risk.en: The lobby needs time to re-register; players may not find the room immediately

zh: 世界启动后很快变为未启动
日志出现 Lua 或 LoadPrefabFile 报错
en: A world starts and then stops
Logs contain Lua or LoadPrefabFile errors

zh: 在 server_log.txt 中查找 error calling LoadPrefabFile in mod workshop-
en: Search server_log.txt for error calling LoadPrefabFile in mod workshop-

zh: 模组文件缺失或版本不兼容
modoverrides.lua 配置损坏
en: The mod file is missing or incompatible
modoverrides.lua is corrupted

zh: 禁用日志中报错的模组
重启世界
确认其他模组依赖是否满足
en: Disable the mod reported in the log
Restart the world
Check mod dependencies

reason.zh: 日志显示该模组加载失败
reason.en: The log shows this mod failed to load

risk.zh: 禁用模组可能影响存档内容，请先确认该模组不是存档必需模组
risk.en: Disabling a mod may affect the save; confirm it is not required

zh: 世界显示启动，但无法进入
日志出现 Lua stack traceback 或 attempt to call global
en: Worlds appear running but cannot be entered
Logs contain a Lua stack traceback or attempt to call global

zh: 在日志中查找 LUA ERROR stack traceback
记录日志中的 session/xxxxx 存档编号
en: Search logs for LUA ERROR stack traceback
Note the session/xxxxx ID in the log

zh: 存档数据损坏，通常是某个模组或异常退出导致
en: Save data is corrupted, often caused by a mod or abnormal shutdown

zh: 备份当前存档
删除日志中提到的存档文件，强制回档
重启世界
en: Back up the current save
Delete the save file mentioned in the log to force a rollback
Restart the world

reason.zh: 日志显示指定存档损坏
reason.en: The log shows the specified save is corrupted

risk.zh: 删除存档不可逆；执行前会自动备份，并要求输入房间名确认
risk.en: Deleting a save is irreversible; a backup is created and the room name must be typed to confirm

zh: 平台磁盘剩余空间低于 5GB
日志或存档可能写入失败
en: Less than 5GB free on the platform disk
Logs or saves may fail to write

zh: 查看平台磁盘剩余空间
检查日志目录和备份目录占用
en: Check free disk space
Check log and backup directory usage

zh: 日志、备份或存档占用过多磁盘
en: Logs, backups, or saves are using too much disk

zh: 清理过期日志
清理旧备份
扩容磁盘
en: Clean old logs
Clean old backups
Expand the disk

risk.zh: 清理日志不会删除存档，但会丢失历史日志
risk.en: Cleaning logs does not delete saves, but historical logs are lost
